rows.name: start: the contract owner (owner4) is Active and has a deferred claimable reward from the real distribution
migrateSeat(contract owner4 -> EOA heir2): SeatMigrated and ClaimableMigrated(owner4, heir2, amount) emitted; claimable moved in full; totalClaimable unchanged
the seat NFT, the Active record and the node key (op4) moved to heir2; the contract owner is cleared and permanentlyExited
heir2 claims the moved reward: exactly the credited amount is paid (balance + amount - fee), ClaimableWithdrawn emitted, claimable 0, totalClaimable reduced by the amount
the old contract owner has nothing left to claim (a claim reverts: nothing to claim)
rows.detail: The contract function "doClaim" reverted with the following reason: BlockRewardDistributor: nothing to claim
